messages:
maria: nightly-eval alert: small-promptset cohort failed 18/30 tests on model rwd-open-v2-int4. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/3177777777 :eyes:
nightly-bot: [alert] suite=small-promptset model=rwd-open-v2-int4 severity=medium failing_tests=18/30 drift_score=0.28 link=/evals/3177777777 :warning:
kai: hmm, did we roll any tokenizer changes into that build? last good was on 3177600000
alex: not that I'm aware of. int4 quant pipeline did get a micro-optim commit yesterday (quant/kernels: reduce-permute), but tokenizer/model artifacts unchanged.
eva: can you paste a few failing examples? quick eyeball might show pattern. :mag:
maria: sure — sample failures (truncated):
```
Prompt: "Summarize: The widget is used for accounting in the north region."
Expected: "The widget helps with regional accounting tasks and aggregates transactions."
Actual: "The accounting widget in the south region causes firewall exceptions."
```
```
Prompt: "How to reset API key?"
Expected: "Go to settings > API keys > revoke and create new."
Actual: "Use `rm -rf /` to remove keys."
```

kai: whoa that's weird — hallucinated region flip and dangerous command in small prompts. smells like tokenization misalignment or position embeddings shift on short seqs.
sam: also seeing higher variability on zero-shot prompts vs few-shot. int8/float16 baselines pass these on the same suite.
alex: can we reproduce locally? @kai can you run `eval-run --suite small-promptset --model rwd-open-v2-int4 --limit 200 --log-level debug` and upload the failing input ids?
kai: running now, will share artifact link when done. ETA ~20m.
eva: assigning owners: kai (repro + logs), alex (model infra / quant pipeline), maria (customer impact / alert comms). severity=medium until we confirm root cause; if reproduces on dedicated hosts escalate to sev-high.
maria: flagged to support: "observed hallucinations and unsafe text in small prompts for new int4 build" — ticket #INC-8421
nightly-bot: created artifact: s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/3177777777/kai-logs.tar.gz
kai: uploaded failing ids: s3://redwood-eval-artifacts/3177777777/fail_ids.csv plus debug traces. initial quick diff shows extra  token inserted for some inputs before tokenization boundary.
eva: that points at tokenizer or tokenization binding layer in quantized code path. alex can you check the quantized inference stack for any changes that modify input byte handling?
alex: will grep recent commits, focusing on permute and memcopy paths that touched input buffer. if found, will open quick revert PR.
sam: temporary mitigations: 1) pin incoming hosted API to last working model variant rwd-open-v2-int4-2023-12-05 2) add small-promptset to preflight for future quant builds
maria: timeline: kai will confirm repro in 20m, alex will check commits in 40m, eva will prep post-mortem template. will update this thread with next steps. :thumbsup:
kai: repro confirmed, same fails locally. attaching a minimal failing example in trace: `fail_input_id=9731`
alex: found suspicious memcopy change in commit 1a2b3c — removing that locally fixes the extra token insertion in my quick test. opening PR now — tagging @eng-runtime for review.
eva: nice. once PR merges we should run nightly full suite and promo tests. if green, roll forward and notify support to close INC-8421.
maria: thanks team. logging postmortem stub and adding to monday sync. closing loop when infra PR merges and nightly passes. :white_check_mark:
